from.place: the finite-extension coefficient construction: properness of the valued field yields a complete DVR of integers with finite residue field

title: A proper rank-one valued field has a DVR of integers and finite residue field
statement: Let l be a prime and let E/Q_l be a finite-dimensional field extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-vector-space-dimension] equipped with the nonarchimedean extending absolute value of [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value]. Assume E is a proper metric space [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-proper]. Then E is complete, its valuation ring O_E={x:|x|_E<=1} is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and its residue field O_E/{x:|x|_E<1} is finite.
